directive: Correct the two verified bibliographic defects exactly: cite Morrison et al. as "Reservoir Designs for Online Paired Experiments" (arXiv v1, 22 May 2025, arXiv:2505.17247) and Zhao--Zhou as Management Science 71(3):1889--1908 (DOI 10.1287/mnsc.2023.02184), preserving the reviewer source anchors in bibliography/related_work. Also make the admissible policy definition operationally explicit: matching decisions depend only on observed covariates/history; when a pair is completed, draw one independent fair orientation sign and assign the two members opposite treatments (clarify timing consistently with immediate assignment and stored-unit status), so treatment randomization is not used by the matching rule. Retain the endpoint-safe coarsening question as the Stage-0 solve target and do not broaden to tuples.
